name: OnePlus 13
notes: PJZ110 = China (ColorOS), CPH2653 = EU, CPH2655 = NA, CPH2649 = India (to confirm). Network/region files are oplusstanvbk (physical) and my_region (logical, inside super).

known_issues.message: ColorOS 17 CN: on the release candidate, 'adb reboot fastboot' left phones stuck (fastbootd crash, bootloader fastboot reboot loop, EDL reflash needed). Do not reboot to fastboot or the bootloader on this build until a fix is confirmed. Use the official rollback to ColorOS 16 instead.
